snippet.title: Pistol Whip - Everything New in Pistol Whip | Oculus Quest, PC VR, PSVR
snippet.description:
Check out the newest action in Pistol Whip, which includes a second fully-voiced cinematic campaign (this time in the Wild West), a pulse-pounding star-studded soundtrack, and the game-changing “Styles” system sandbox allowing players to create an unstoppable action experience that’s exactly what you want.

Find a preferred Style that’s uniquely your own and a style-specific leaderboard will be created. New weapon types and gameplay modifiers transform Pistol Whip and are available in all scenes with Styles. Giddyup, Heroes!

Coming to Oculus Quest and PC VR with PlayStation VR on August 12, 2021!

The Fall - Dabin
